The womb is as loud as a vacuum cleaner 😱

80-90 decibels of constant noise — heartbeat, blood flow, your voice — 24/7.

That's why newborns sleep better with white noise. It sounds like home.

Human babies are the chubbiest primates on Earth 🐒👶

Chimp babies are born lean. Human babies are born with up to 15% body fat.

Why? It's not cuteness. It's fuel. Human brains are enormous — and they need a fat reserve to keep growing.

#babyfacts #evolution #science #factsunlocked #didyouknow #parenting #babies

Babies cry in an ACCENT 👶🌍

French newborns cry with a rising melody. German newborns cry with a falling one.

They learn their language's rhythm inside the womb and start using it from day one.

Nature is unreal.
